title: Fancy Housemade Soda
description: Okinawa sugar and foraged rosemary meld together to yield a distinctly herbal, cola-like note in this house made aromatic soda. Skip the club soda and reach for a bottle of sparkling mineral water instead for a drink with boosted texture and mouthfeel.

items.name: Dark sugar (such as Okinawan black sugar, jaggery, or panela)
Good mineral water, to serve (like Vichy Catalan, Gerolsteiner, or if you absolutely must, Perrier)

steps.body: Combine the rosemary, filtered water and sugar in a saucepan or Dutch oven. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to simmer for 20 minutes.
Strain and decant into a sterilised jar.
Serve over rocks with mineral water and add fresh fruit or additional herbs if desired.

notes.label: Storage
notes.body: Store the syrup in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.
